content.short: CowSwap is a DeFi app on Ethereum that settles buy and sell orders by matching users' wants.
content.description: CowSwap is a decentralized finance app on the Ethereum blockchain that settles buy and sell orders by matching users through a coincidence of wants (CoW). This approach aims to prevent slippage and reduce fees. Orders that do not find a peer-to-peer match are routed to CowSwap’s automated market maker. The system lets users execute trades at competitive on-chain prices across exchanges and aggregators, such as Uniswap and Sushiswap. By pooling liquidity and routing trades through a unified framework, it strives for fair, automatic execution across markets.
